question: List the last name of all the students who majored Law and Constitutional Studies.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "students_with_majors" AS SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, j.major_id, j.major_name FROM table_2 AS m LEFT JOIN table_1 AS j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id
S:
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  last_name
FROM students_with_majors
WHERE major_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    lower(major_name) = 'law and constitutional studies'
    OR lower(major_name) = 'law & constitutional studies'
  )
  AND last_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(last_name) <> ''
ORDER BY last_name;
'''
